description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMonitoringMiddleware' for AWS SDK client-side monitoring, handling event collection, socket communication, and middleware logic in PHP.

classes.name: AbstractMonitoringMiddleware
classes.description: An abstract middleware class for AWS SDK to handle client-side monitoring, including event data collection, socket communication, and request/response processing.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a specific header from an AwsException response if available.

methods.name: getResultHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a specific header from the metadata of a ResultInterface.

methods.name: getExceptionHeader
methods.description: Extracts header information from an exception, if it implements ResponseContainerInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with handler, credential provider, options, region, and service.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, collects event data if enabled, and manages asynchronous promise handling.

methods.name: getNewEvent
methods.description: Creates a new monitoring event array with API call details.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the AWS region associated with the middleware.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the AWS service name associated with the middleware.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if monitoring is enabled via options.

methods.name: populateRequestEventData
methods.description: Adds request-related data to the event array.

methods.name: populateResultEventData
methods.description: Adds response-related data to the event array.

methods.name: isSocketCreated
methods.description: Checks if the UDP socket has been created, adapting to PHP version.

methods.name: prepareSocket
methods.description: Creates or resets the UDP socket connection for monitoring.

methods.name: sendEventData
methods.description: Sends event data via UDP socket to the monitoring agent.

methods.name: unwrappedOptions
methods.description: Unwraps options if they are wrapped, defaulting on errors.
